about: What the json-cites region reads a JSON document as, in two worlds: a place of the tree and a published folder. What it emits over these cases is the reader: an edit that emits the same over them keeps what it read, an edit that emits otherwise reads the tree again.
Each case is a document as the reader was handed it, chosen so that together they reach every family the reader answers.

  "A rotation breaks nothing. n keys are admitted; one is lost; k of the n that remain admit a replacement",
  "with an epoch; the lost key's window closes; every claim it signed inside its window still verifies,",
  "and whatever it signs after the close is refused with the key named. There is no recovery by mail and",
  "nothing is exported: a rotation is claims on keys/<id>, signed by the lock itself.",
  "",
  "`verify` is the same stand-in as signers.json: a line verifies against a public key when its `sig` is",
  "`ok:` followed by that key. Epochs are plain integers."

{
  "about": [
    "viol* and the premium g = viol − viol*. On a chain, g is identically",
    "zero for any monotone valuation — planning is worth nothing, the",
    "retreat is already optimal. Off a chain it need not be.",
    "",
    "The trap: reporting gated = coarse − gain as the optimum. That equals",
    "viol* only under collapse (g = RI). The square-by-index valuation on",
    "B2 has g = 0 and RI = −4 at (x, y), so gated is not best."
  ],
  "coverage": {
    "size": 3,
    "criterion": "a chain (g = 0), B2 under height (modular, g = 0), B2 under square-by-index at (x, y) where gated is not licensed",
    "could_exclude_counterexamples": true,
    "why": "the structural form and the closed gap are crossed against the sweep by this file's runner, over every pair of four scales"
  },
  "cases": [
    {
      "name": "five-chain, counting, (all, none)",
      "chain": ["none", "own", "team", "region", "all"],
